'''Gormo Vosadii Grasso''' was a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] and the owner of the [[Gus Treta Inner-System Market Station]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He worked with the ''Scion''{{'s}} builders [[Hoersch-Kessel Drive, Inc./Legends|Hoersch-Kessel Drive, Inc.]] to stack modular expansions atop the station. He was dishonored among the [[Vosadii]] for a botched [[Spice/Legends|spice]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] enterprise.
